description: This file defines a Java interface for configuration settings related to signal enrichment in the Eclipse Ditto services, including nested enum for default config values.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentConfig
classes.description: A Java interface providing configuration methods and constants for signal enrichment settings, including nested enum for default values.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the class name of the signal-enrichment facade provider.

methods.name: getProviderConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object for the signal-enrichment facade provider.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the configuration as a Config object.
